messages.message: Help me reason about an Ember API test that still fails after a patch.
When an Ember fix fails, reproduce it again, inspect the new evidence, and revise the diagnosis instead of repeating the same patch.
Do not edit anything yet; give me the investigation sequence.
The failure is inside a legacy Ember fixture with no complete suite.
Name the focused reproduction we should preserve.
For that legacy fixture only, run the focused reproduction and state plainly that the full suite is unavailable.
Keep that limitation explicit in the result.
